p:
We have been entrenched in a battle with the Syndicate for years. What they lack in skill they make up for in numbers. It's impossible to kill them off fast enough to have any noticeable impact on their population!
We've found that the best way to deal with their size is to pilfer their emblems. Once an emblem is stolen the shamed member is 'dealt' with internally.
Pick their pockets clean and turn the emblems in to me or one of the other guards.
Start at Durnholde, south of here.
c: Hey, nice work! Keep this up and the other rogues might stop spitting on you.

d:
Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
You must see Dazalar in Dolanaar. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.

c: Yes, it is time to train you...

p: I need more armor scraps, friend! Do you have any?
c: Thanks again, friend. You do the Horde proud...

d:
I have relegated my second, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, to deal with Moonglade's call for aid. Speak to him on this matter - NOT me.
Let me give you some... Friendly... Advice. It is I who led us out of the darkness - NOT the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade - when all was lost for our race. Teldrassil gives us all new life! They would have you believe otherwise, and to believe their propaganda would be a fool's task.
I'll leave it to you to decide whether or not you're a fool.
c:
Yes adventurer, thank you for coming. I apologize about the misunderstanding... The air is thick with mistrust between the Arch Druid here and Keeper Remulos in Moonglade. Each suspect the other of chicanery, and the fact that strange corruptions of Teldrassil continue unabated are still an issue here. It does little to quell mistrust.
Regardless, our duty to the Cenarion Circle remains... Even if those who lead it may disagree with one another.

d:
For this task, Keeper Remulos' majordomo in Moonglade - Rabine Saturna - seeks aid in exploring the vast wastelands far to the west of Tanaris... And even further west of Un'Goro. You should find him in Nighthaven, the main village of Moonglade.
While your work will no doubt be of tremendous benefit to us all, I advise you to tread gingerly. There are tensions between Darnassus and Moonglade... Ones that may grow over the course of time.
c:
I am Rabine Saturna, and on behalf of Keeper Remulos and all of the denizens of this sacred glade I bid you welcome.
I appreciate your interest and eagerness to assist the Cenarion Circle. I also know that Arch Druid of Darnassus expressed his displeasure to you in your lending us aid. Rest assured that it is for the greater good, and that you will be safe from any ill-conceived repercussions you may be the target of.
You are among friends here, friend.

p: Friend, we need more armor scraps to supply our troops!
c:
These are some good pieces, friend. I can use them to fashion new equipment for our troops.
If my supply level gets high enough, then maybe our seasoned fighting units will enter the field!
